boilerplate.headline: About Exploreans
boilerplate.body: Exploreans is a small collection of places with character, where every stay is measured in what you do, discover and feel. Every experience is led by someone who belongs to the place. Mara River Camp in the Maasai Mara and Watamu Beach Club & Villas on the Kenyan coast are the first places to carry the name. Exploreans is part of Planhotel Hospitality Group.

media.headline: Images and group news
media.body: Photography and the latest group news are in the Planhotel Media Centre. For Exploreans images in high resolution, ask the press team.
